seo.title: HDD & SSD Media Storage in Kyiv — IT Asset Logistics
seo.description: Physical storage of HDDs, SSDs and other data-bearing media in Kyiv: individual identification, agreed handling and documented receipt and release.

hero.label: Media Storage & Handling

h1.before: Physical storage and handling of data-bearing media in Ukraine.

hero.lead: Keep your HDDs, SSDs and other storage media in Ukraine until you're ready for their next use, return or further processing.
paragraphs: We receive, identify and store physical data-bearing media in Kyiv under agreed handling conditions.
Receipt, storage and release records help you keep track of your media, while returns or transfers are arranged according to your instructions.
hero.illustration_label: Illustration: hard drives and solid-state drives with generic identification tags

what_we_handle.label: What We Handle
what_we_handle.title: Physical storage media, individually accounted for.
what_we_handle.intro: We provide physical storage and handling for data-bearing media removed from [corporate IT equipment](/equipment-hub/) or retained for future use, return or further processing.

items.title: Hard Disk Drives (HDD)
items.text: Internal hard drives from computers, servers and other corporate equipment.

items.title: Solid-State Drives (SSD)
items.text: Solid-state storage devices requiring physical storage and documented handling.

items.title: Other Data-Bearing Media
items.text: External drives, removable storage devices and other media may be accepted by prior arrangement.

what_we_handle.note: Media can be received individually or in packaged batches. Identification and recording procedures are agreed according to the type and quantity of media.
what_we_handle.disclaimer: We do not access or process the data stored on these devices as part of the storage service.

handling.label: Storage & Handling
handling.title: Documented handling from receipt to release.
handling.intro: We organise the physical storage of data-bearing media according to agreed procedures, maintaining records of received, stored and released items.

steps.title: Receiving
steps.text: We receive individual media devices or packaged batches, confirm the number of items or packages and record visible packaging conditions.

steps.title: Identification
steps.text: Media or packages are registered using available serial numbers, labels or agreed identifiers. The level of individual recording is defined with the client.

steps.title: Storage
steps.text: Accepted media are placed in designated storage locations, with access and handling arrangements agreed in advance.

steps.title: Release
steps.text: Media are released or prepared for transfer according to authorised client instructions. The handover is documented.

note.title: Physical handling only.
note.text: Our storage service concerns the physical devices. We do not inspect, access, copy or modify the data stored on them.

after_storage.label: After Storage
after_storage.title: Your media. Your decision.
after_storage.intro: When storage is no longer required, we arrange the next step according to your instructions.

items.title: Return to Owner
paragraphs: We prepare the stored media for collection or coordinate their return to the client.

items.title: Authorised Transfer
paragraphs: Media can be released or transferred to an authorised recipient according to agreed instructions, with the handover documented.

items.title: Media Destruction
paragraphs: If physical destruction is required, we can coordinate a separate service through REISSWOLF Ukraine.
Destruction arrangements, pricing and supporting documentation are agreed separately.

after_storage.note: Storage does not include data erasure or media destruction. These operations require separate authorisation and service arrangements.

cta.label: Get in Touch
cta.title: Need to store physical data-bearing media in Ukraine?
cta.lead: Tell us what types of media you need to store, the approximate quantity and any specific handling requirements.
paragraphs: We'll review your request and discuss a suitable storage arrangement.
